iOS 27.2 is coming soon, bringing several new features to iPhone users, including a Messages feature that appeared in the iOS 27 beta but was later pulled: Suggestions.

Messages「Suggestions」功能在 iOS 27 beta 被抽走後，於 iOS 27.2 重新回歸

During this summer's entire iOS 27 beta testing period, one of my favorite AI features was a new addition to Messages — and it didn't even feel like AI: Suggestions.

以下是根據 Apple 官方說明介紹其功能：

Suggestions appears as a small, convenient action button beneath the message it relates to.

As shown in the screenshot below, if someone asks you to do something, you might see a suggestion button that lets you add that item to Reminders or Notes. Or when a message mentions an event, Suggestions can help you easily add it to your calendar.

Suggestions worked well for me during the iOS 27 beta period, but right before the public release in the fall, Apple delayed the feature to a "future software update."

And now in iOS 27.2 beta, Suggestions is back. And one of the changes may explain exactly why it was pulled in the first place.

As I mentioned, Suggestions performed as expected during this summer's testing. But if I had one complaint, it was that it sometimes popped up in situations where the message content wasn't really relevant. Sometimes I'd see a suggestion to add content to Notes, Reminders, or Calendar when there was no obvious reason in the message to trigger those suggestions.

But so far, in my testing of iOS 27.2, the Suggestions appearing in Messages conversations have been reduced. And when they do appear, I can clearly understand why they're being suggested.

Hopefully this feature will launch alongside the official iOS 27.2 release in a few weeks.

What do you think of the Suggestions feature in iOS 27.2? Feel free to share your experience in the comments section.
